sections.Profile:
"Trade Winds" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in June 1962. Designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features a nautical theme, capturing the adventurous spirit of sea exploration. The playfield includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and a kick-out hole.
